title: fix(app-shell): a lookup field's inspector offers no Relationship name box, which wrote a key the spec does not declare (objectui#12758)
body:
Fixes #12758
Clause-②: no

## What changes

The object field inspector no longer renders the "Relationship name" text box on `lookup`, `master_detail` and `tree` fields. That box wrote `relationshipName` onto the field definition. The installed `@objectstack/spec` (18.0.0-next.2) `FieldSchema` declares no such key under any spelling, so the client spec check put the field in the banner, and every autosave of the object came back `422 INVALID_METADATA` with `unrecognized_keys` at `fields.NAME`. The 422 also hit the saves of later, unrelated edits on the same object.

- `ObjectFieldInspector.tsx`: the `InspectorTextField` bound to `def.relationshipName` is removed. The header comment records why there is no such control, written in the same form as the retired `Indexed` toggle's note.
- `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`: `designer.field.relationshipName` and `designer.field.relationshipNameHint` leave both tables (en and zh).
- New pin file `ObjectFieldInspector.relationshipNameRetired-12758.test.tsx`.
- `.changeset/12758-lookup-relationship-name-control.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.

Nothing else on the lookup inspector changes.

## Why remove, not rebind (the spec measurement)

The governing rule is "spec 声明 > 实现 > 文档面": where code and spec disagree, the code follows the spec. Before choosing, I read the installed spec for a key with this meaning (an inverse collection key on the parent) under any spelling:

- Over the whole installed `@objectstack/spec` package, including `src`, `dist`, `json-schema`, `CHANGELOG.md` and `spec-changes.json`: `relationshipName` has 0 hits. The positive control `relatedListTitle` has 291 hits in the same tree.
- `FieldSchema`'s alias table (the `aliases` block of its strict object, plus `FIELD_KEY_GUIDANCE`) has no row for `relationshipName` and no row that points at an inverse-collection key.
- The nearest declared keys are `relatedList`, `relatedListTitle`, `relatedListColumns` and `relatedListFilter`. They decide how the child collection is SHOWN on the parent's detail page: its prominence, its title, its columns and its filter. None of them names the collection as a key, so none carries this meaning. `relatedListTitle` is a display title, not an identifier.
- Readers: on objectstack `origin/main` `b74434c58`, the only hits are `service-analytics` function parameters that carry a field NAME (`obj?.fields?.[relationshipName]`), not this field key. In this repository, the inspector and its two strings were the only hits. No test referenced them.

So the spec declares no target key. The control is removed, and no migration is built. Declaring an inverse-collection key would be a separate spec card, with its own business pull.

## Readings, before and after

Backend: objectstack `66d456d01`, `examples/app-crm`, `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`, used as a backend only. The writable package `com.qa.vrf` (namespace `qavrf`) holds `qavrf_job` and `qavrf_rel`, and `qavrf_rel` has the lookup `job` pointing to `qavrf_job`. The console runs on Vite from this branch's worktree, proxied to that backend, in Chromium with real keystrokes.

**REST** (the contract, the same backend both times):

| request | answer |
|---|---|
| `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qavrf_rel?package=com.qa.vrf`, `fields.job` with `relationshipName: "jobs"` | **422** `INVALID_METADATA`, `fields.job [unrecognized_keys]`: "Unrecognized key(s) on this field: `relationshipName`. Until this shape was closed these were dropped silently ..." |
| the same body without that key | **200** |
| `GET` afterwards | `fields.job` = `{"type":"lookup","label":"Job","reference":"qavrf_job"}` |

**Chromium, before** (console at `main` `ed43c79`, unchanged):

- On `qavrf_rel.job`, the "Relationship name" label count is 1, and the "Inverse collection key on the parent" placeholder count is 1.
- Typing `jobs` brings the banner at about 1 s: "Fields → job: Unrecognized key(s) on this field: `relationshipName`. ..."
- The autosave PUT returns **422**. The body it sent was `fields.job` = `{"type":"lookup","label":"Job","reference":"qavrf_job","relationshipName":"jobs"}`.
- A later, ordinary Description edit autosaves with `relationshipName` still on the field, and returns **422** again. The panel stays "Unsaved".

**Chromium, after** (this branch, `8fcc84a`):

- The "Relationship name" label count is 0, and the placeholder count is 0. "Related object" is followed directly by "Picker config".
- The same Description edit autosaves with **200**. It sent `fields.job` = `{"type":"lookup","label":"Job","reference":"qavrf_job","description":"probe edit"}`.
- The banner never shows "Unrecognized key". The panel reads "Saved".

## Pins, each red on `main` and green here

The pin file uses the real inspector inside a parent that feeds each patch back into the draft, as the designer pages do. The sweep is key-agnostic: on each of `lookup`, `master_detail` and `tree`, it types into every text box the inspector offers. Only the API-name box is skipped, because a rename re-keys the field. So a control that writes an undeclared key under any label turns the pins red.

- **PIN 1**: no text box writes `relationshipName`, for each of the three types. A field that already carries the key does not bring the control back.
- **PIN 2**: every draft the sweep produces judges with zero `unrecognized_keys`, both under `ObjectSchema` from `@objectstack/spec/data` and under the console's `validateMetadataDraft('object', ..., { mode: 'edit' })` at `fields.job`. A control case proves both judges DO report the key on this field, so a judge that never reports cannot pass PIN 2.

**Ablation (one run, both pins).** I committed the fix first. Then objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` planted `main`'s control into `ObjectFieldInspector.tsx` and its en strings into `i18n.ts`. Each anchor hit once, and each blob changed (`fca77b0` to `3a3008a`, `2a09456` to `06e0e0a`). The on-disk marker counts read 1 and 1.

- Planted: **7 failed | 1 passed (8)**. The one green is the judge control, which must hold both ways. The PIN 1 reds read `expected { type: 'lookup', label: 'jobs', ... } to not have property "relationshipName"` (and the same for `master_detail` and `tree`). The PIN 2 reds read `expected [ { path: 'fields.job', ... } ] to deeply equal []`.
- Restored: `blob == HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` is empty for both files. The marker counts read 0 and 0.
- The test resolves the inspector by its relative `src` import, with no `dist/` in the path, so no rebuild sits between the legs.

## Local gates (all at `8fcc84a`)

| command | result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' run build` | exit 0 (scope 29 of 47) |
| `pnpm exec vitest run` over the new file and every `ObjectFieldInspector*.test.tsx` (repo-root form) | exit 0, Test Files 20 passed (20), Tests 243 passed (243) |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` | exit 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists the new pin file. |
| `eslint` on the three changed source and test files | exit 0, 0 errors. The 11 warnings are the same 11 that `ObjectFieldInspector.tsx` carries at `main`. |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | exit 0 |
| `pnpm check:new-line-citations` | exit 0, 0 new citations |
| `pnpm check:i18n-keys` · `check:i18n-designer-parity` · `check:i18n-dead-keys` · `check:i18n-drift` | each exit 0. Parity reads every en row with a zh row. Drift reads 2 keys removed and 0 values changed. |

The full farm is CI's.

## Acceptance notes (observations, not filed)

- **A stored `relationshipName`.**
  - The designer's retired-key path does not name it. `RETIRED_FIELD_KEY_TOMBSTONES` in `@object-ui/types` has no entry, so none of its three strip sites (the read door `readFields`, `MetadataService`'s carry-over, `MetadataFieldsPage`'s carry-over) drops it, and it would ride back out to the PUT as a 422.
  - The unrecognized-key path DOES name it: the console check reports it at `fields.NAME` with the spec's own message. PIN 2's control case pins that it is reported. The `formula`-style pointer is `formula`-only, so this message has no pointer.
  - Whether any stored document carries the key is not measured. The server refuses to store it today, and its own refusal text says that before the shape closed, such keys "were dropped silently".
  - No migration is built, because the spec declares no target key. Per the dispatch, no strip at save is added either.
  - Carrier: none.
- **Spec history.** I could not read whether `FieldSchema` ever declared the key. Both local checkouts are shallow: the objectstack pickaxe's control leg `relatedListTitle` lands on the window edge `492598eae`. So the history is NOT MEASURED here. The current-spec reading above is what decides this change.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
